mutations.contract: A part with a declared occurrence is drawn at that one only.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff model_v2_is_the_end_stop_linkage_in_five_bodies_and_the_nav_switches_models (2026-11-08). Keeps every occurrence of the pinned mesh, which is five pitch arms on a one-blade model.

mutations.contract: A part is measured at its own occurrence, never at every slot its mesh is drawn at.
mutations.note: Measures a declared part at every drawn slot of its mesh: two lugs' bushings on one mesh, and a bore ranked against both offers the other lug's (a_take_on_a_lug_feature_binds_that_lugs_own_face).

mutations.contract: A dimension within one part is not a mate: its bound other end is never ranked against.
mutations.note: The rule before 2026-11-22: v2's flanged-bushing lug bores were offered the plate's own spindle bore (face 487), with a Take, through the radius dimension from the spindle axis.

mutations.contract: A dimension of one part is within it, whatever part its end nodes name first.
mutations.note: Reads the dimension by its end nodes only: the plate pilot-to-fastener dimension ends on the piston-body pattern node, which names the body first, and the plate pattern was offered the plate own spindle bore ahead of its holes (a_seat_and_a_pattern_get_contact_suggestions_too, 2026-11-23).
